rules: L4.2 DESCENTS: FLOAT MODE (loop bypass valve opened progressively while the swash ramps to zero over >= 3 s) replaces 'pump at neutral'; bypass-open proof switch, failure -> alarm and stop on the friction brakes
L4.2 T04: Ø1.2 orifice in EACH motor's T04 port, hard lines or 4SH hose downstream of the choke, 2-CHANNEL BP-vent switch (a double failure is information only)

Any trip (CCO overspeed, 24 V loss, s30) ramps the H1P053 to neutral over >= 3 s: EDC control orifices / PLUS+1 ramp, the hydraulic ramp is the fail-safe one (AWAIT Danfoss orifice size, no contact without the owner)

L4.2: MS05 2-speed valve FAIL-TO-1st (de-energized = 468 cc); 2nd coil fed through a PNOZ s30 >= 1.5 mph contact; 24 V loss -> normally-open loop bypass = FLOAT, so no hydrostatic retarding (bypass failed closed + 24 V loss = double failure, information row)

T04 release line pressure switch: on loss of T04 release pressure it opens the BP vent (emergency) FIRST; the T04 release supply comes from the loco's own loop (steering 7: LP shuttle + 20 bar reducing valve + normally-vented solenoid; loss of loop/charge applies the T04) and every apply path passes a choke Ø2.4 + 1.0 L damping accumulator so the T04 engages >= 1.0 s after the vent and builds over >= 2.0 s (L4.2 with the Ø1.2 port orifices: calc 1.01 / 4.21 s) (a fast 0.5 s T04 still gives 50 kN - NG, so the choke is REQUIRED; size AWAIT Poclain data, verify by a timed test at commissioning)
Direction change only at zero speed (PLUS+1 interlock, wheel-speed < 0.1 mph) plus >= 1 s swash ramp through neutral
runin.basis: Stress Bot s4 lumped-mass model (k 20/100 kN/mm, 1.0 mm total play), tender brake 5.845 kN (TB-3.13d 0.671 m/s2), loco brake 0.69, tender 8,706.5 kg

brake_match.result: MATCHED within 2 %: loco 0.690 / tender 0.671 (TB-3.13d, mixed Coremo D 2N sets, pad wear limit 5.5 mm) / coaches 0.12 g on empty tare; tender slightly softer -> tender buffs onto the loco, covered by the run-in check; service 4.08 kN

route_LV.rule: High-rail gauge-face lubricators on ALL R <= 80 curves (Routes F, E, D); top of rail kept DRY for 2 % starts. Closes K2-rD (D: lubricated margin 1.33)

stop_7mph_QEV.delay_basis: extra loco delay = spring-apply exhaust time (option A to 0.3 bar g, conservative) + 0.5 s signal ASSUMED, on top of the 1.5 s train reaction
stop_7mph_QEV.result: 7 mph trip stop on 2 % down: option A worst 21.7 m, option B worst 20.1 m vs 30 m (single failures, dry/wet/dusty)

chain.L4_error: L4 D2-f used dL = dC and L = C (slack 0.75 of 1.93 mm) - corrected here (Stress Bot r2)
rules: Hard vertical bump stops +/-22 mm axle vs truck frame (primary travel 25 kept as the case/seal-plate envelope)
Axlebox lateral (side) float <= +/-1 mm (thrust faces shimmed); chain-line coplanarity at install <= 0.4 mm with the axle centred

RE-SHIM PROCEDURE: restore body/coupler height for wheel wear with shims at the CENTRE PLATE / side bearers (body-truck), NEVER under the primary springs. A primary re-shim (spring set) is limited to 3 mm total and is ALWAYS followed by a motor-slide reset: loosen the 4 x M20, re-set the sag to 17-20 mm at ride height with the chain line horizontal +/-3 mm, re-torque 610 N.m, record
Sag 17-20 mm at static ride height, checked monthly / 100 h; chain replaced at 2 % elongation (HARD limit; 3 % no longer allowed)
Oil level: lower strand immersed 20-25 mm static (was 6-12) so the lead axle stays immersed when it lifts on a climb; or a slinger (CWF option)
chain.verdict: PASS: with the corrected geometry the slack lasts to 30.8 mm of bump at sag 17 (chain line horizontal) vs the 22 mm stop (margin 1.40); 28.0 mm with a 3 mm primary shim. A 10 mm primary re-shim without a motor reset would give 22.4 mm - NOT permitted by the procedure.

chain.reversal: zero-speed interlock + >= 1 s ramp: impact factor ~1.3 -> ~42.5 kN vs 51.7 kN allowable (0.82)

hot_case.criteria: SF >= 1.5 at HPRV; >= 1.0 at HPRV x 1.5 and at a ramp-limited reversal (impact 1.3, PLUS+1 >= 1 s through zero)
hot_case.verdict: PASS: shrink-only 0.15-0.20 keeps SF >= 1 at HPRV x 1.5 with a 30 K hot hub and the removal groove; the groove is KEPT (removal only). Oil-pressed assembly DELETED.

hub_fit.assembly: SHRINK ONLY: heat hub to 200-230 °C (expansion 0.33 mm at ΔT 190 K > 0.20 + 0.10 assembly clearance); NO oil pressing. Oil-injection groove (6 wide, in the hub bore, mid-length) + plugged M8 port for removal only

speed.stop_rule: L4.2: stroke stop 42 cc sealed + HARD tamper-sealed 2,600 rpm engine limit (no high idle above rated): 5.96 mph loaded in 2nd; no-load 6.47 mph (eta_v 0.99); 7 mph trip independent

operating_rules: Descents (L4.2): FLOAT MODE - brake handle out of RUN -> swash ramp to zero over >= 3 s with the loop bypass opening -> motors free-wheel; the friction brakes (independent / train) alone control speed on down grades (sized for the full 2 % descent of the loaded train: 41 % of service force, cooler 3.3 of 14 kW)
Dead-loco towing: open the tow (loop bypass) valve, wind out the T04 parking brakes (T04 release), motors to 2nd/freewheel; max tow speed 2 mph (ASSUMED until Poclain confirms case pressure)

Reverse starts of the full train only on grades <= 1.20 % (L4.2: 1.10 margin with sand on both trucks and the centre-plate pad included; PLUS+1 reverse pull cap 30.0 kN; forward TE command limit 33.0 kN for K2-a)

Wheels: driver condemning diameter Ø1430 (new Ø1450), pony Ø630 (new Ø650); FLANGE HEIGHT WITHDRAW limit 28 mm TRAIN-WIDE (re-profile to <= 27 mm) + 2 mm vertical rail-head wear limit at joints (L4.2); measured diameters entered in PLUS+1 at each gauging
Sand (both trucks, every driven axle in the direction of travel) is mandatory for starts on wet rail and pre-sand on grades >= 1 %; level + flow proof; hill-hold until TE is established
Wind (interim): 25 mph wind limit on R <= 80; no full-pull starts on R <= 80 while any lubricator is out of service

pony.spring: pony primary spring rate <= 1.19 kN/mm per wheel (static deflection >= 5 mm governs; the 1.23 twist limit is not binding) - track twist 1:200 at R80, Stress Bot s5/r3
